title: Scroll Renew
html:
Monster drop: Skeleton, Goblin Mage

How to get it

Teaches Renew, a level-2 Restoration spell. Needs 20 Intellect and Restoration skill 5 to learn and to cast.

Drops from any monster that casts spells, level 8+.

  • Restoration scrolls come from any caster, whatever school it casts.
  • The monster’s level picks the spell level: 8+ drops level-2 scrolls, 18+ level-3 and 30+ level-4.
